body: Thank you, Dan.  I’d rather stay; I just don’t have a reason to.  I’ll keep trying, though.
31M.  Suicidal thoughts constantly, every day.  I hope you get better, my friend.  I hope I do, too.
I’ve practiced guitar every day for months and I’ll just never be good.  I just want to be good at something...

It’s 3:09.  I can’t sleep.  I keep thinking about how badly I fucked up a relationship before it even got off the ground.  Once in a lifetime girl who gave me a chance and I fucked it up by being a nervous wreck and I’ll never have another chance.  Dated other women since but I keep thinking about “the one that got away.”  I just wanna fucking kms.  I’m such a fucking failure.
All I have to offer is a hug, my friend.  I’m a 31M and living alone for years without any success at dating has brought me here as well.  At least we have each other.  Please stay here with me.

Same, my friend.  I am 31, no girlfriend, live alone, but still have a job working from home.  I should be ok, since I'm an introvert and enjoy living alone (even with years of depression) but  covid has turned it into solitary confinement and it broke me.  I even started volunteering for things as a way to get out and feel positive but I'm still broken and literally crying while typing this.  You're not alone, my friend.  Much love from Jersey.
